summary: Build reusable features, feature stores, and MLOps workflows in practical feature engineering training. Explore the course and enrol your team.
lede: Enterprise feature engineering helps experienced data and analytics professionals turn source data into reliable, reusable inputs for machine learning. The course develops practical skills in profiling and validating data, building point-in-time training datasets, documenting feature definitions and lineage, and planning offline and online serving workflows. Participants create a feature inventory, a reusable feature specification, and a production-readiness roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for advanced data and analytics professionals who already work with structured data, machine learning workflows, or enterprise reporting and need to make feature engineering repeatable across teams.
modules: Feature Transformation with dbt and Spark
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with supervised machine learning workflows, relational data, and either Python or SQL. Working knowledge of pandas, data pipelines, and model evaluation will help you complete the exercises efficiently. No production feature store experience is required. Coding is required at a working Python or SQL level, while advanced topics such as embeddings and automated feature generation receive conceptual treatment rather than technical engineering depth.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
